lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg8Fe4Ga4 (Mg2FeGa) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms in the unit cell across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements adopt eight-coordinate, body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements, with Fe and Ga each surrounded by eight Mg neighbors, and Mg by four Fe and four Ga neighbors, all at 2.8099 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Mg-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, edge-sharing between Fe- and Ga-centered polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among like-centered Mg polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
